div.head: IV As 6.7
div.ab: Si serua ancilla sit et ipsa furetur alicubi preterquam domino suo et (uel) domine sue, adeant sexaginta et uiginti ancille et afferant singule tria ligna et comburant eam unam ancillam et conferant totidem denarios, quot serui deberent, aut uerberentur, sicut de seruis dictum est.

Si serva ancilla sit et ipsa furetur alicubi præterquam domino suo et dominæ suæ, adeant sexaginta et viginti ancillæ et afferant singulæ tria ligna et comburant eam unam ancillam, et conferant totidem denarios, quot servi deberent, aut verberentur, sicut de servis dictum est.

In the case of a female slave who commits an act of theft anywhere except against her master and mistress, six and twenty female slaves shall go and bring three logs each and burn that one slave; and they shall pay as many pennies as male slaves would have to pay, or suffer scourging as has been stated above with reference to male slaves.
div.note: Latin only; no German translation in Liebermann.
